messages:
marta: Kicking off a controlled weighted canary to eu-west1 green pool at 03:45 UTC. initial 10% weight, quiet window 25m. target release v3.2.3.
deploy-bot: Job started: redwood-service:v3.2.3 -> green (eu-west1). job_id=job-77c4. healthchecks=ok.
marta: Observability plan: watch client error_rate (1m/5m), p95, and upstream 502/503 counts. Abort if error_rate +0.7pp OR p95 +150ms OR upstream_5xx > 0.4%.
kevin: I'll run the lb change. Confirmed lbctl --force privileges. Also setting a short grace-drain for connections.
anita: FYI I'm toggling circuit-breaker thresholds to be more conservative during probe.
deploy-bot: Router action: /usr/bin/lbctl set-weight --region eu-west1 --from blue --to green --weight 10 --pin cookie=green-v3.2.3. op=op-44d1
sre-oncall: Oncall is monitoring. Alerting rules set to page on p95>400ms or error_rate>1.2%.
marta: Ramp command if stable at 25m: 
```
/usr/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to green --weight 30 --grace-drain=60s --reason "ramp-to-30pct-canary"
```
(25 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Probe snapshot (t+25m): error_rate 1.9% (baseline 0.25%), p95 510ms, upstream_5xx 0.95% (window=1m).
kevin: Seeing 5xx spike from service-db on green instances. Connection queue depth high.
anita: Abort now. Executing rollback to full blue. Rolling back to 100% blue.
marta: Rollback cmd issued: 
```
/usr/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to blue --weight 100 --reason "abort: upstream 5xx spike"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback applied. Traffic -> blue 100%. op_id=op-44d2.
deploy-bot: Auto-incident created: INC-2026-221. Link: https://tracker.redwood/inc/INC-2026-221
sre-oncall: Postmortem stub created; capturing tcp dumps and DB pool metrics for 03:40-04:10 UTC. Paging DB infra team.
kevin: For safety I'll set a temporary client cookie pin to blue-temporary to avoid new sessions on green until fixed. Adding maintenance banner.
release-manager: Noting for release notes: "v3.2.3 canary halted and reverted due to DB upstream 5xx and increased latency in eu-west1. Green pool quarantined pending DB pool/backoff fix."
anita: I'll prepare a hotfix branch with connection backoff + pool tuning. Proposed hotfix deploy window tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Change request CHG-914 filed.
marta: Agreed. No permanent pins — we'll keep blue active and schedule a smaller 5% probe after the hotfix. Closing thread unless more alerts.
